assets.name: 虎纹奶油
assets.look: warm ivory cream board, thin dark brown outline, orange paw print corners, orange haired tiger girl with red gingham bow and gold bell peeking over upper RIGHT edge, striped tail on RIGHT
assets.prompt:
Use case: background-extraction. Asset type: transparent PNG background for a real Chinese IME skin, nine-slice stretchable.
Input image is a reference/edit target: isolate ONLY the candidate-preview board at the right, including its little tiger girl and attached ornaments. Remove the whole surrounding settings UI. Recreate this board cleanly as a standalone front-facing asset. Preserve the reference character identity, line style, palette and decorations: warm ivory cream board, thin dark brown outline, orange paw print corners, orange haired tiger girl with red gingham bow and gold bell peeking over upper RIGHT edge, striped tail on RIGHT.
CRITICAL remove ALL text, numbers, sample candidates, annotations, percent labels, separator lines and row highlights: the board interior must be completely empty uniform pale ivory for runtime text. No baked lettering anywhere.
Composition: 1024x768 transparent canvas. Board rectangular rounded body occupies approximately x=40..950 y=285..735. Character above the upper RIGHT corner occupies x=580..940 y=35..295, all tail ornaments within canvas. Board edges axis-aligned straight except corner rounding. Middle x=350..450 is an undecorated stretch-safe vertical strip through panel and top/bottom borders; y=470..550 is a stretch-safe horizontal strip through panel and side borders. Keep all small ornaments outside central text space, confined to corners. Solid opaque pale ivory interior, true transparent exterior. A single board ONLY, no mockup, no UI controls, no text, no checkerboard.
